data.one_liner: Live password validation widget with progress bar, checklist, and Unicode-aware rules.
data.what_it_does: Displays a checklist and progress bar under any TextField that update on every keystroke to show which password rules are met or unmet. It supports Unicode characters, custom rules, NIST policies, password generation, and form validation.
use_when: You need live visual feedback for password creation requirements in a sign-up or change-password form.
You want to share the exact same password policy validation logic between your Flutter frontend and Dart backend.
avoid_when: You only need standard form validation without real-time checklist and progress UI elements.
strengths: Unicode-aware counting for multi-script, emoji, and accented passwords.
Shareable password rules package with backend support.
Extensively customizable UI, animations, strength labels, and custom item builders.
weaknesses: Limited to password validation and checklist UI use cases.
data.minimal_example:
FlutterPwValidator(
  controller: controller,
  rules: const PasswordRules(
    minLength: 8,
    uppercase: 1,
    lowercase: 1,
    digits: 1,
    special: 1,
  ),
  onSuccess: () => setState(() => canSubmit = true),
  onFail: () => setState(() => canSubmit = false),
)
